retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-inspired layout featuring massive, interlocking bubble lettering with vibrant gradients positioned above a rounded-corner photo frame containing double-exposed vintage portraits.

recipe.visualDefinition: A split composition where the top half is dominated by thick, overlapping custom lettering with a warm-to-cool gradient, and the bottom half features a rectangular image with rounded corners showing a group of figures in a hazy, blue-tinted double exposure.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking typography that fills the upper horizontal third
Rounded-corner frame separating text from image
Vibrant warm-toned text contrasting with cool-toned blue photography
Repetitive floral or sunburst motifs integrated into the text background
coreInvariants: Thick white outlines around all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale display text at the top; group portrait centered in the bottom two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, bulbous first letter of the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the vibrant title to the secondary arched text, ending on the photographic subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background at the very top and sides to frame the central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Magenta and pink background behind the text.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan and light blue within the photographic frame.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and orange gradients in the lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the top half; desaturated, low-value tones in the bottom half.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, rounded sans-serif with extreme weight
letterConstructionRules: Zero internal counters or very small ones
Thick white stroke separating letters from the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Descenders and ascenders are absorbed into the circular body of the glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Massive custom display type paired with a smaller, arched secondary sans-serif for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the era's weight and curves

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1960s style layout with a black top border. The bottom 70% is a rounded-corner frame containing a blue-tinted, hazy double-exposure photo of a group of people in vintage hats. Above the frame, place a vibrant magenta background with a purple sunburst motif.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, interlocking bubble lettering across the top magenta section with an orange-to-purple gradient and thick white outline. Add a secondary arched line of yellow text across the top edge of the photo frame.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a thick white outline?
Is the bottom photo frame rounded at the corners?
Are the letters overlapping and bulbous?
Is the photo tinted blue and hazy?

mustAchieve: Soft, dreamlike quality in the photography
avoid: Clean, sharp digital edges in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white outline is consistent around all letters.
Ensure the gradient flows vertically from orange to purple.
Verify the photo frame has a distinct white border with rounded corners.
Confirm the secondary text follows the arc of the sunburst motif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Bulbous Gradient Typography] with [Rounded Frame Double Exposure Photography] using a [1960s Psychedelic] color palette.
